objects.description: During [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0004), threat actors used [SombRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0615) in conjuction with [CostaBricks](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0614) and [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194).(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)
objects.description_fa: در طول [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0004)، عوامل تهدید از [SombRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0615) همراه با [CostaBricks](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0614) و [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194).(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)
